{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check arm vs severity cross-tab
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], margins=True))

# Check for sample_seq duplicates per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
df_with_max_seq = df.merge(sample_seq_max, on='patient_id', suffixes=('', '_max'))
print(f"Rows with sample_seq not equal to max for patient_id: {df_with_max_seq[df_with_max_seq['sample_seq'] != df_with_max_seq['sample_seq_max']].shape[0]}")"}
